### 1. Architecture Overview
- The OpenTelemetry Collector core (repo `opentelemetry-collector`, knowledgeId `f3537db5-0b7d-4942-8809-75ac43e2066f`) defines the foundational `Component` interface in `component/component.go`, which all plugins (receivers, exporters, processors, connectors, extensions) implement. Currently it only requires `Start` and `Shutdown`. Adding `Capabilities() ComponentCapabilities` here is a breaking interface change that must propagate to every plugin interface and helper across core and contrib.
- Signal-specific component contracts embed `component.Component`:
  - Receivers (`receiver/receiver.go`), Exporters (`exporter/exporter.go`), Processors (`processor/processor.go`), Connectors (`connector/connector.go`), Extensions (`extension/extension.go`) all import `go.opentelemetry.io/collector/component`.
- Consumer capability plumbing already exists and is reused by processors/exporters/helpers:
  - `consumer/internal/consumer.go` defines `Capabilities` struct and `BaseConsumer` with `Capabilities()`.
  - `consumer/consumer.go` re-exports `Capabilities` and `Option`, and provides `WithCapabilities`.
  - Helpers and middleware use capabilities: `processor/processorhelper/processor.go` (default mutates), `exporter/exporterhelper/internal/base_exporter.go` (WithCapabilities), `service/internal/graph/capabilities.go`, `service/internal/graph/consumer.go`, `service/internal/capabilityconsumer/capabilities.go`.
- Tests and test scaffolding rely on component interfaces: `component/componenttest/*`, `otelcol/otelcoltest/nop_factories.go`.
- Downstream embeddings (Tempo, Jaeger v2, contrib) import `go.opentelemetry.io/collector/component`, so they must implement the new method.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Core interface change point**
  - File: `component/component.go` defines `type Component interface { Start(ctx, host) error; Shutdown(ctx) error }` (~L25-62) (metadata & content). This is where `Capabilities() ComponentCapabilities` must be added. (metadata shows summary and section map; content lines 25-62).
- **Consumer capabilities definition**
  - File: `consumer/internal/consumer.go` defines `Capabilities` struct and `BaseConsumer` interface with `Capabilities()` (~L7-18) and `BaseImpl.Capabilities()` (~L36-38) (metadata summary).
  - File: `consumer/consumer.go` re-exports `Capabilities` and `Option`, and `WithCapabilities` (~L22-26) (metadata).
- **Helpers referencing capabilities**
  - Processor helper: `processor/processorhelper/processor.go` default `WithCapabilities` sets mutates data true (~L51-57) (metadata).
  - Exporter helper: `exporter/exporterhelper/internal/base_exporter.go` option `WithCapabilities` (~L223-231) (metadata).
- **Graph and capability nodes**
  - `service/internal/graph/consumer.go` defines `baseConsumer` wrapper for `consumer.Capabilities` and `consumerNode` (~L11-17) (metadata).
  - `service/internal/graph/capabilities.go` defines virtual capabilities node for pipelines (~L15-28) (metadata).
  - `service/internal/capabilityconsumer/capabilities.go` (purpose lists capability-enforcing wrappers).
- **Component-specific interfaces embedding Component**
  - Receivers: `receiver/receiver.go` (imports `component`, interfaces Traces/Metrics/Logs embed `component.Component`).
  - Processors: `processor/processor.go` (Traces/Metrics/Logs embed `component.Component`; factories).
  - Exporters: `exporter/exporter.go` (Traces/Metrics/Logs embed `component.Component`; factories).
  - Connectors: `connector/connector.go` (Traces/Metrics/Logs embed `component.Component`; factories).
  - Extensions: `extension/extension.go` (Extension embeds `component.Component`).
- **Test scaffolding using component.Component**
  - `component/componenttest/*` (nop host, telemetry, config validation).
  - `otelcol/otelcoltest/nop_factories.go` builds nop factories for all component types (imports `component.Component` in factories).
- **Downstream consumers (cross-repo awareness)**
  - Contrib repo (`opentelemetry-collector-contrib`, knowledgeId `11013c10-9fdc-4638-8651-c1f2abb23c81`) imports `go.opentelemetry.io/collector/component` broadly (e.g., connectors, receivers, exporters, tests).
  - Tempo repo (`tempo`, knowledgeId `1b0ae06b-32ba-4e1c-b75f-a7238d305255`) integrates collectors (`modules/distributor/receiver/shim.go` imports component).
  - Jaeger v2 repo (`jaeger`, knowledgeId `790f96e7-a83d-46f2-8868-4e80e0b32313`) embeds collector in CLI and extensions and imports `component`.
- **Changelog and coding guidelines**
  - `CHANGELOG-API.md` documents breaking API changes (purpose).
  - `docs/coding-guidelines.md` (mentioned in semantic search) sets standards.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| opentelemetry-collector | component/component.go | Defines Component interface (Start/Shutdown). Must add Capabilities() ComponentCapabilities (content shows interface ~L25-62). |
| opentelemetry-collector | consumer/internal/consumer.go | Defines Capabilities struct and BaseConsumer.Capabilities(); base plumbing for capabilities. |
| opentelemetry-collector | consumer/consumer.go | Public aliases and WithCapabilities option; exposes Capabilities type. |
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/receiver.go | Receiver interfaces embed component.Component; must add Capabilities implementation/propagation. |
| opentelemetry-collector | processor/processor.go | Processor interfaces embed component.Component; factory and settings rely on Component. |
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/exporter.go | Exporter interfaces embed component.Component; factory uses Component. |
| opentelemetry-collector | connector/connector.go | Connector interfaces embed component.Component; factory uses Component. |
| opentelemetry-collector | extension/extension.go | Extension interface embeds component.Component; must implement new method. |
| opentelemetry-collector | processor/processorhelper/processor.go | Helper sets default WithCapabilities (mutates data). Needs to surface/align with new Component method. |
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/exporterhelper/internal/base_exporter.go | Uses WithCapabilities option; must align with new Component Capabilities. |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/graph/consumer.go | Wraps consumer.Capabilities; internal graph needs to satisfy new Component method. |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/graph/capabilities.go | Virtual capabilities node; interacts with consumer capabilities. |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/capabilityconsumer/capabilities.go | Capability-enforcing wrappers for consumers (purpose). |
| opentelemetry-collector | component/componenttest/* (configtest.go, nop_host.go, nop_telemetry.go, etc.) | Test scaffolding uses component.Component; must update to implement Capabilities. |
| opentelemetry-collector | otelcol/otelcoltest/nop_factories.go | Provides nop factories for all component types; must add Capabilities implementation. |
| opentelemetry-collector | CHANGELOG-API.md | API changelog should record the breaking interface change. |
| opentelemetry-collector | docs/coding-guidelines.md | Coding standards; may need update note for new method. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | (multiple files importing go.opentelemetry.io/collector/component, e.g., connector/countconnector/connector.go, receivers, exporters, tests) | All plugins in contrib must implement the new method because interfaces embed component.Component. |
| tempo | modules/distributor/receiver/shim.go (and related) | Embeds collector receivers; will need to satisfy new Component method. |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/components.go and related (imports component) | Jaeger v2 embeds collector; all its components must implement the new method. |

**Notes for implementation:**
- Define `ComponentCapabilities` (likely new type) in `component/component.go` alongside the interface, or reuse consumer `Capabilities` if appropriate. Add `Capabilities() ComponentCapabilities` to `Component`.
- Update all component interfaces (receiver/exporter/processor/connector/extension) to implement/satisfy the new method.
- Update helpers and test nop components/factories to return appropriate default capabilities.
- Run and fix compilation across core, contrib, tempo, and jaeger; update API changelog.
